purpose: Apply the V26 workflow to the frozen quiet-inventory information-repricing mother event inside the independently frozen causal BULL state: review every 2014-2020 signal chart, distinguish genuine information repricing from terminal-distribution breakouts, and compress observations into at most five causal rules before any 2021-plus challenge aggregation.
translation: exact T20_H60_QUIET_INFORMATION_REPRICING; next legal open, +20% target, H60, no stop, 40 bps round trip

market_state.definition: BULL when completed cross-sectional median ret20 and ret60 are both positive and the positive-return shares at both horizons are both strictly above 0.50

chart_rule_development.review_order: outcome bucket, then chronological contact sheets

review_axes: whether the prior 40-session inventory is genuinely horizontal or already late-stage elevated
whether turnover contracts progressively before the breakout
whether the breakout is the first clean range escape or a repeated failed escape
whether the demand bar is accepted without an excessive next-open chase
whether longer-term price structure shows fresh price discovery or terminal distribution

outcome_governance.2021: not permitted in visual rule discovery
outcome_governance.2022_2023: previously consumed mother-signal outcomes but not permitted in rule discovery
outcome_governance.2024_plus: not permitted in this chart build
outcome_governance.interpretation: post-hoc development anatomy, not independent confirmation
